{{Quote|Grief cuts sharper than stalks of kuvu grass left too long in the light of the suns, and I know my grief bled from every pore.|[[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Dariana]] on grief|<ref name="A Mother's Memoirs, Concluded">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050413memoirs|text=A Mother's Memoirs, Concluded}}</ref>}}
'''Kuvu grass''' was a plant on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When dried, it hardened and it's blades became sharp enough to cut skin.
